text:
priya: Heads-up — canary with redwood-7b-awq-v2 (AWQ runtime + act-quant) is seeing repeatable decode stalls when group_size=64 and actq=2. Partial tokens stream then nothing. Repro steps + logs below.

priya: repro steps:
```
# canary run
./runner --model redwood-7b-awq-v2 --quant awq --group-size 64 --act-quant 2 --batch-size 4 --input-file samples/short_prompts.jsonl
```
logs show decoder hang at step ~120 for several prompts. no OOM, threads alive, but socket stops sending.

eli: @priya thanks for the repro. Is this on batcher v3 or the legacy batcher?

priya: batcher v3. Also noticed KV cache size looks smaller than expected (kv_len ~= 4800 vs expected 5120) right before the stall.

mike: Can repro locally with single-threaded runner but only on longer prefixes. Quick check: is there any recent change to packer or alignments?

sara: quick suggestion — try lowering group_size to 32 or disable activation quantization (actq=0) as an experiment. If stalls stop, likely actq packing or alignment bug.

priya: did group_size=32 test: no stalls in 2k samples. actq=0 also passes. So reproduces as a combo: group_size >=48 + actq=2 => flaky.

jordan: I pushed a temporary canary rollback to group_size=16 for prod-canary to stop customer impact.

deploy-bot: rollback deployed: service redwood-inference/canary-redwood-7b updated to group_size=16 (by jordan) — 2 pods replaced, health checks passing :white_check_mark:.

qa-bot: quick evals run on openqa-dev set: with group_size=64+actq=2 we see ROUGE-L drop ~1.8 and hallucination rate +4.2% vs baseline (fp16). With group_size=16 actq=2, metrics align with baseline.

eli: hypothesis: packer in AWQ changed activation packing order (tile vs row-major) which, combined with grouped attention offsets, causes wrong byte offsets when group boundaries cross kv-page. That would produce silent decode hangs (consuming wrong KV slice).

mike: would be helpful to get a hex dump of the kv buffer at stall point and the attention offsets. I can add small dump hooks to runner.

priya: attaching minimal log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-18T17:02:15Z] decode: step=118 tokens_emitted=64 kv_offset=4912 kv_len=4800
[2026-03-18T17:02:15Z] runtime: act_quant_pack: group_idx=0 group_size=64 tile_bytes=8
[2026-03-18T17:02:15Z] decode: waiting for kv slice (offset 4912..4992) but kv_len=4800 => read past end => stall
```

sara: that log line nails it — kv_offset > kv_len. That sounds like an off-by-one / packing alignment rounding bug when group quantization inserts padding.

eli: I'll open a patch to make packer emit explicit pad bytes and add an assert in runtime read that checks kv_offset <= kv_len. If assert trips, we fail fast instead of hang. Patch gist in a sec.

mike: also add a short-term mitigation: clamp reported kv_len to next-group boundary in the runtime to avoid read past end (but still surfacing a metric).

eli: patch uploaded (WIP):
```
- // packer: emit groups
- emit_group(data, group_size);
+ // packer: emit groups and pad to alignment
+ emit_group(data, group_size);
+ if (pad_needed) emit_zero_bytes(pad_needed);
```

priya: sounds good. I'll run full 5k-sample regression after patch and post numbers. For now prod canary stays at group_size=16.

jordan: thanks team. please add a short postmortem note to the canary channel once we have root cause and revert plan.

priya: will do. updating ticket INF-4421 with logs + QA diffs. cc @eli @mike for follow-up. :thumbsup:
